key.name: toasts-enabled
key.summary: Show a popup when a track changes

key.name: toast-position
key.summary: Where popups appear

key.name: toast-duration
key.summary: Seconds a popup stays before fading out

key.name: toast-max-visible
key.summary: Maximum popups shown at once

key.name: toast-hide-when-app-focused
key.summary: No popup when the player's window is focused

key.name: toast-hide-in-fullscreen
key.summary: No popups over fullscreen windows (games, videos)

key.name: toast-respect-dnd
key.summary: No popups while Do Not Disturb is on

key.name: toast-shadow
key.summary: Soft shadow under popups

key.name: toast-muted-apps
key.summary: Players that never show popups

key.name: focus-mode
key.summary: Focus mode: hide all popups

key.name: toggle-focus-mode
key.summary: Shortcut to toggle focus mode

key.name: menu-style
key.summary: How players look in the top bar menu

key.name: card-layout
key.summary: Where things sit on a card
key.description: standing-volume: progress under the text, volume standing on the right. side-volume: a small volume beside the cover. slim: one row, progress on the edge. cover-volume: scroll on the cover for the volume.

key.name: card-volume-style
key.summary: Look of the standing volume on cards

key.name: list-layout
key.summary: Where things sit on a list row
key.description: cover-volume: scroll on the cover for the volume, progress along the bottom. one-line: one line under the text is the progress, and turns into the volume from the speaker. two-bars: progress and volume side by side.

key.name: list-bars-order
key.summary: Which bar is on the left in the two-bars list layout

key.name: cover-volume-animation
key.summary: How the cover shows the volume while you scroll on it

key.name: menu-background
key.summary: Background of the top bar menu
key.description: 'music' takes the colors of the song that is playing.

key.name: design
key.summary: Look of the menu cards
key.description: 'cover' is a gradient; vinyl, wave, leds, road and cassette are animated scenes.

key.name: design-color
key.summary: Color of the design
key.description: 'cover' takes it from each album cover.

key.name: design-opacity
key.summary: How opaque cards are, in percent

key.name: popup-design
key.summary: Look of the popups
key.description: 'cover' is a gradient; vinyl, wave, leds, road and cassette are animated scenes.

key.name: popup-design-color
key.summary: Color of the design
key.description: 'cover' takes it from each album cover.

key.name: popup-design-opacity
key.summary: How opaque popups are, in percent

key.name: settings-version
key.summary: Which settings layout these values were written for (for updates)

key.name: animations
key.summary: Dancing bars and moving scenes

key.name: show-panel-label
key.summary: Show the current track next to the icon

key.name: panel-label-max-chars
key.summary: Maximum length of the top bar label

key.name: hide-when-idle
key.summary: Hide the top bar button when nothing is playing

key.name: show-audio-only-apps
key.summary: List apps that play sound but are not players (games, calls)

key.name: pause-others
key.summary: Pause other players when one starts playing

key.name: pause-others-exceptions
key.summary: Players that are never paused by another one starting

key.name: media-keys-target
key.summary: Which player the media keys control
key.description: 'default' leaves the choice to the system.

key.name: media-keys-pinned
key.summary: Player the media keys control when pinned

key.name: browser-bridge
key.summary: Let the Earful Bridge browser add-on show each tab as its own player
key.description: Registers Earful's small helper program with the browsers on this computer. Turning it off removes the registration.
